name: vllm-ascend on Huawei Ascend NPU
description: AccelMark runner for Huawei Ascend 910B/910C NPUs using vllm-ascend (vLLM community fork for CANN). Supports Suites A–F. NPU memory queried via torch_npu. FP8 excluded: not supported on current Ascend 910B/910C hardware. W4A16 uses gptq backend (Marlin kernels not available on CANN).
notes: DP (data-parallel) support for dual-die Ascend 910C: auto-detects dies_per_card via npu-smi, launches one engine per die with ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES binding, merges throughput. max_num_seqs automatically divided by dp_size to avoid shm_broadcast contention.
